drills.title: Soft Plunge to the Saucer
drills.text: Plunge lightly so the ball dribbles down the hidden top-right path and settles in the lock saucer. It repeats for more every time you make it and hands you a Smart Missile, so this is the plunge to default to rather than the riskier one.

drills.title: Toy Box, Then Saucer
drills.text: Hit the Toy Box to light the lock, then put the ball in the lock saucer, then relight and go again. The lock has to be relit for every ball you bank, so the drill is the cycle, not either shot on its own.

drills.title: Standup Sweep
drills.text: Work the left three, the center pair and the right four as three separate aiming problems, and learn which flipper reaches each bank cleanly. Spelling the name is what qualifies the shot multipliers, so a sloppy sweep costs you the multiplier, not just the target points.

drills.title: Soft Taps by the Magnet
drills.text: Take the two targets flanking the toy box with soft, controlled left-flipper shots rather than full swings. Both have to go down to arm the right-outlane save, so treat it as a two-target routine you finish rather than a single lucky hit.

drills.title: Ramp-to-Ramp Loop
drills.text: Alternate the left ramp and the center ramp without letting the chain break; each looped ramp registers as a combo and the values escalate fast. Save this for a ball where one of the two already carries a multiplier.

drills.title: Strobing Arrow Chain
drills.text: Make any major shot, then take one of the arrows that strobe on the other majors for a couple of seconds afterwards. Keep going while the window stays open — this is the base combo engine underneath every named combo on the machine.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: Think of it as your ammo clip. The button holds Smart Missiles earned from skill shots and mystery awards, and each one spots a lit shot in a song mode for free. Its other job is quieter but worth more: it aborts a Toybox Multiball start so you can keep stacking locks.

uses.when: Song mode running with shots still lit
uses.what: Fires a Smart Missile to spot a lit shot, and you also collect whatever else was lit there.

uses.when: A nasty left-side shot is holding you up
uses.what: Missiles always take the leftmost lit shot, so save them for the ones you'd rather not risk.

uses.when: Three or more balls locked in the toybox
uses.what: Press to abort the multiball start and keep locking — the game holds up to six.
Stop pressing and let it rip: six-ball Toybox Multiball runs at double base jackpot value.

howItPlays.objective: Run the show: choose songs at the record scoop, spell the band name for shot multipliers, and stack balls in Jacky's Toy Box. Clear all nine songs to earn the Final Tour grand wizard.
loop: Choose a song at the left scoop, run its lit shots, then Crank It Up and close it out for that song's Super.
Spell the band name across the standups to arm the X inserts, then drop an X onto a ramp.
Trade the left and center ramps back and forth for Walk This Way, spending your multipliers on the loaded ramp.
Beat the Toy Box to arm the lock, lock at the saucer for Toy Box Multiball, and run both orbits for Elevator Multiball.
Flip the DUDE lanes to build your bonus multiplier, and finish every song for Final Tour.

lights.name: AEROSMITH Standups
lights.lit: Every dark standup is a band-name letter still owed, spread over a bank of three on the left, a pair in the center, and four on the right.
lights.then: Finish the name to arm the X inserts, then run a major shot wearing a flashing X and it stays doubled the rest of the ball. Put an X on all the majors for a roving triple you can drop wherever you like.

lights.name: DUDE Inlanes
lights.lit: A lit return lane is a DUDE letter you have yet to bank; roll a ball through a lit one to collect it.

control.effect: a flick of either flipper button slides the lit DUDE inserts across the return lanes, letting you park the letter you still owe under the lane the ball is dropping toward
control.when: any moment before the ball drops into the return lanes

lights.then: A collected letter stays banked, so you only ever hunt the lanes still lit, and finishing the word bumps your bonus multiplier across the whole end-of-ball tally. Dude Looks Like a Lady lights every lane when you Crank It Up.

lights.name: Record Scoop Songs
lights.lit: The record insert at the left scoop blinks when a song is yours to pick or swap, and every song burns its own set of shots.
lights.flashing: Thumb the flipper buttons to roll through the choices before you take the scoop, which locks whatever is highlighted.
lights.then: Run the song's shots, then come back to the scoop to Crank It Up and finish it for its Super. Rats in the Cellar off the spinner and Back in the Saddle off the pops make the gentlest openers.

lights.name: Walk This Way Ramps
lights.lit: Finishing any major shot lights the arrows on the rest for a beat or two, and the two ramps are the pair you swing between for Walk This Way.
lights.flashing: A strobing arrow is a live combo -- catch it before the beat closes to bank it doubled, and each catch feeds the next.
lights.then: Rock the left and center ramps back and forth for combos that snowball, and hold it for a ball where a ramp is already carrying a multiplier. That loaded ramp under Super Ramps and a doubled playfield is the source of the game's monster shots.

lights.name: Toy Box Multiball
lights.lit: Beat the Toy Box to arm the saucer lock, and Jacky's magnet dunks each ball you feed it into the box.

control.effect: once three or more sit locked, a tap kills the multiball start so you can keep piling on locks -- the box takes six, and a six-ball launch doubles the base jackpots
control.when: when the game asks whether to launch the multiball

lights.then: Launch on three for the deepest-scoring multiball on the game, then re-lock two mid-play to crack open a twenty-second tripled playfield. Grind the eight-shot jackpot ladder while it lasts.

lights.name: Elevator Multiball
lights.lit: Both orbits arm the elevator lock, and a lit Elevator banks the locked ball -- Premium and LE can substitute the drop target.
lights.then: Stack three at the Elevator to open a three-ball round, then swap between the majors and the Elevator for jackpots that climb. There is no playfield multiplier here, so it tops out under Toy Box.

lights.name: VIP Pass Ball Save
lights.lit: The pair of targets hugging the Toy Box arm the VIP Pass, and dropping both lights the right-outlane save.
lights.then: Nudge them down with soft, measured left-flipper taps beside the magnet rather than swinging full. Once the save glows, a right-outlane drain kicks the ball back to the shooter instead of ending the ball.

lights.name: Mini-Playfield 2X
lights.lit: On Premium and LE only, the five standups tucked behind the upper mini-playfield flipper light for backhands.
lights.then: Backhand the lot, then run the loop exit to double every point for a minute; stack it over a loaded ramp and a multiball for the compounding total. Pro tables only ever see this as a Mystery Double Scoring award.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: A flick of either flipper button slides the lit DUDE inserts across the return lanes; park the letter you still owe under the lane the ball is dropping toward, roll through to bank it, and completing the word bumps your bonus multiplier for the end-of-ball tally. Dude Looks Like a Lady lights the lanes when you Crank It Up.

scoring.text: Lean on the soft plunge into the lock saucer for the Hidden Skill Shot and a Smart Missile. Take a gentle song like Rats in the Cellar, arm the VIP Pass save on the two Toy Box targets, and start stacking locks.

Spell the band name to arm the X inserts and drop one onto a ramp, then farm the two-ramp combos of Walk This Way. Stack Toy Box locks for the deep multiball, run the orbits for Elevator, and flip the DUDE lanes to build your bonus multiplier.

Clear all nine songs to earn Final Tour, the grand wizard, where you tour twenty-four cities in sets of eight shots under every multiplier for a hundred-million Super Jackpot. Medley is the mini-wizard on the road there, and a fully loaded ramp under Super Ramps and a doubled playfield is where the eight-figure single shots live.
